Also refuted if the A-38 weekly re-check on a full HDD join shows power burn matching heating's share of weekly variance in Dec-Feb.

confirmations.what_changed_for_the_next_test: the forward wind/solar DENSITY is now served (weather_forcing_forecast, S114/A-51). Until g24 the gate could only be checked against a D+2 STALE realized wind number; it can now be checked against a forecast, which is the form the play actually needs.

tests.falsifier: A second summer week at breadth<=1 delivering a >=+100 Bcf build, or a summer draw arriving at breadth>=4, refutes the exclusion at its stated strength. The coverage falsifier: if adding the missing Southeast BAs (A-18) materially moves the breadth of past weeks, the count was a coverage artifact and must be re-measured before further use.

confirmations.what_the_run_did: STOOD DOWN ON 8 OF 10 DAYS, and NOT on season or scope - it was UNCOMPUTABLE. Two specialists found it independently: the play keys on the gas share RISING week over week, and the state served the share as a LEVEL plus a change in MWh, with no last-week denominator.
confirmations.the_deeper_cause_found_after_the_run: the play's own conditions[].state_path was PROSE - 'grid_stack.bas.*.gas_share (weekly rise count)' - which resolves to nothing. Found by the A-46 evaluability sweep, not by a specialist.
confirmations.why_this_matters_more_than_the_test: this was the block's CENTREPIECE play, the summer-scoped one from the monthly weather/burn mapping, and it failed silently. A play whose input is absent does not fail loudly - it stands down, reads as 'considered and declined', and nothing counts it.
confirmations.fixed: grid_stack now serves gas/wind/solar/hydro *_share_chg_7d and the state_path is repointed. Re-resolved against the g24 slice it is now EVALUABLE and reads ARMED (gas share +0.0135). The MWh delta was never a valid substitute: on 20260727 gas MWh FELL 82,071 while gas SHARE ROSE.
confirmations.verdict: NOT a test of the claim - a test of the plumbing, which failed. RE-REGISTER against the next summer block, where it can now actually run.

tests.falsifier: Forward shoulder days where large warm-removals (<= -1.0 GWDD) deliver DOWN days at ordinary base rates refute the shoulder inversion. Forward days where the census's largest revisions deliver the largest moves refute the size inversion. If high-disagreement days (>=0.7 GWDD spread) stop containing disproportionate outcome width, the authority channel claim falls.

confirmations.what_the_run_did: EVALUATED and FIRED on 5 of 10 days - the most-used weather play of the block. D-0723 applied its scope clause correctly, excluding EIA print Thursdays from its sign claims.
confirmations.the_limb_that_could_not_run: its named AUTHORITY CHANNEL - model_disagreement - was 100% NULL for the entire block, so the high-disagreement arbitration limb was dark on all ten days. Named by 8 of 10 specialists as the run's highest-cost gap. E-0722: it is 'the authority channel the brain names as the arbiter for exactly the one observation my call rests on'.
confirmations.cause_found_and_fixed: a BUILD-ORDER defect - the store was built 8 minutes before the raw MOS archive landed - and the empty-but-PRESENT record SHADOWED the on-the-fly recompute fallback, which only fires when a date is MISSING. Rebuilt; h0/h1 now carry all 16 metros.
confirmations.verdict: the sign-map limb is REPORTED and survived its day; the authority limb is UNTESTED and must ride the next block, where the channel is live.

tests.falsifier: A forward week landing beyond its month's listed seven-year extreme by more than ~15 Bcf refutes that month's gate at its stated strength - single-week, listable, cannot be missed. The anchor gates specifically: any February week shallower than -40, any May week below +45, any August week above +80, any October draw, any December build, any November week beyond ~+/-120. The hydro-asymmetry limb is refuted if a fall-shoulder freeze arrives and hydro cover proves irrelevant to the gas response.

confirmations.what_the_run_did: Evaluated and did not fire. Its falsifier is single-week and listable: a forward week landing beyond its month's seven-year extreme by more than ~15 Bcf. The two prints inside g24 were +32 (07-23) and +28 (07-30) against a July seven-year p50 of +48 - well inside the listed August/July bounds, so no tail arose to test the gate.
confirmations.why_not_settled: a gate that is not approached is not confirmed. This is the correct outcome for a quiet mid-summer block and carries no information either way.
confirmations.note: the storage series was a full print stale during the run (fixed S114), so the specialists saw +41 where the decision-legal print was +32/+28. It does not change this verdict - all three are inside the same bounds - but the next test must run on the corrected series.

tests.falsifier: If forward runs emit magnitudes above 550 on days whose drivers support it AND capture on |actual|>900 days does not improve above the measured 18-37% band, the ceiling was not the binding constraint and this play is wrong. Equally refuted if raising emissions degrades sum|err| - i.e. if the cap was doing useful work - which would mean the honest bar is correctly calibrated and the loss is elsewhere.

confirmations.what_the_test_was_watching_for: emissions CAPPING at ~550 where drivers support more, with capture on |actual|>900 days stuck in an 18-37% band.
confirmations.what_actually_happened_and_it_inverts_th: the cap did not arrive at 550. THE MAXIMUM EMISSION OF THE ENTIRE BLOCK WAS 250, against a maximum realized move of 1,360. Measured per event (D37): mean|guess| / mean|actual| = 0.29x, UNDER-emitted on 8 of 10 days, per-day ratios 0.18 to 0.40 with no clustering. The trend across blocks is DOWNWARD: g22 0.55x, g23 0.68x, g24 0.29x.
confirmations.verdict: THE TEST WAS AIMED AT THE WRONG NUMBER. It cannot be confirmed or refuted as written, because the failure mode it describes did not occur - a worse one did. A 550 ceiling was never the binding constraint on this block; something is holding emissions at roughly half that.
confirmations.three_competing_explanations_none_promot: (a) the mission brief's stand-down passage biased small - several specialists named 'a confident wrong number is expensive and a declared stand-down is cheap' as the line that did the most work; (b) shrinking was CORRECT - four specialists wrote that their number moved toward zero because the brain refuted the instrument their read rested on (D-1 flow at 44% next-day, heavy_buy_aggression 4/9); (c) the block was genuinely hard (gw_hdd 0.0, model_disagreement dark, a roll seam splitting the block).
confirmations.how_to_tell_them_apart: (b) predicts under-emission CONCENTRATES on days whose specialists declared a refuted channel; (a) predicts it is UNIFORM. It is uniform here, which leans toward (a) - but n=1 block and the three are not exclusive.
confirmations.the_replacement_test: vary the brief's stand-down passage, hold everything else, and compare the emission ratio on the next block. Re-register with the bar at the MEASURED ceiling (~250), not 550.

tests.falsifier: If specialists run under the seven-step order and (a) no posterior shows a pre-influence read differing from its post-chain estimate, or (b) emissions still cap at ~550 where drivers support more, or (c) no override is ever declined for lacking an independent read, then the order changed no behaviour and is ceremony. Refuted also if ordering the steps DEGRADES sum|err| against the s105.3 baseline.

confirmations.limb_a_no_posterior_shows_a_delta: NOT MET (so not refuted). At least 6 of 10 posteriors report a pre-influence read differing from the post-chain estimate, and 20260723 FLIPPED SIGN (pre-influence DOWN, chain UP), attributable to two named scope clauses rather than to judgment. Four specialists stated the brain removed the centre of their own read.
confirmations.limb_b_emissions_cap_at_550: NOT MET, BUT THE TEST WAS AIMED AT THE WRONG NUMBER. Emissions did not cap at 550 - they capped at 250, and mean|guess|/mean|actual| = 0.29x against g22 0.55x and g23 0.68x. Under-emitted on 8 of 10 days. See run_findings.g24 THE_DOMINANT_NEGATIVE. The order is not refuted by this, but the emission problem GOT WORSE in the session that introduced the order and the brief, and that must not be scored as a win.
confirmations.limb_c_override_declined_for_lacking_an_: MET. B-0727 declined weekend.carry_realization_flip; C-0721 declined firing on ICE LD1 when the play's stated path is NYMEX, calling it 'goalpost-moving toward a conclusion I already held'.
confirmations.degradation_check_vs_s105_3_baseline: NOT DEGRADED. sum|err| 4,890 vs g22's 5,965 on a market only 6% quieter (mean|actual move| 497 vs 527).
confirmations.honest_caveat: n=1 block. The order and the mission brief landed together, so their effects are not separable on this run.

tests.hypothesis: Greg, S114: 'That will probably help clear up our unattached days and part of the drift.' The mission brief tells a specialist the path is ONE continuous object sampled at eight times, that each point inherits from the one before, and that its day is a link in a chain rather than a standalone estimate. If the unattached-day and drift problems are partly an ORIENTATION fault - agents told to do math and never told the values flow together - the brief should move them.
tests.what_is_measured_and_it_does_not_need_th: These are SHAPE properties, measurable on a contaminated rehearsal as well as a fresh run, which matters because g22/g23 have already seen the curve (D39: we test ON the runs, not against them). (a) ATTACHMENT: day N's emitted close level vs day N+1's emitted open level - the count of days that do not connect. (b) CONTRACT ARITHMETIC: first path point == 0 and last == (day-move minus gap); S110 measured g23 at 8 of 10 days mismatched, both Mondays by exactly +400. (c) STEP STRUCTURE: path segments that move with no named liquidity event between them. (d) DRIFT SHARE: |drift| as a fraction of sum|err| - the 'survives' number, which is the part of the error that does NOT cancel and is therefore the part a continuity fault would produce.
tests.falsifier: REFUTED if, under the brief, (a) the unattached-day count and the contract-arithmetic mismatch count are no better than the s105.5 baseline, AND (b) drift share is unchanged or worse. Refuted independently if specialists report the brief but their posteriors show no reference to inheritance between points - i.e. it was read and not used. NOTE THE ASYMMETRY: a fall in drift share alone does NOT confirm it, because drift share also falls when the market gets quieter - that exact artifact produced the fake 939 -> 592 'improvement' (realized moves fell 799 -> 457 over the same span). Confirmation requires the mechanical counts (a) to move.
tests.baseline_named_per_A1: s105.5 blind, same block. g22 blind of record: 4/10 direction, sum|err| 5,965, drift -1,815, survives 30%. The mechanical counts (attachment, contract arithmetic) must be computed on that committed blind BEFORE the rehearsal, or there is no baseline to beat.

confirmations.a_contract_arithmetic: MOVED HARD. Contract violations 0 of 10, against the g22 blind of record at 10 of 10 and g23 at 9 of 10.
confirmations.c_step_structure: largest-single-step share p50 0.22, against g22 0.32 and g23 0.29. No day carries a step above 60% of its travel.
confirmations.THE_QUIETNESS_ARTIFACT_THE_FALSIFIER_WAR: mean |actual move| g22 527, g23 457, g24 497. g24 was NOT meaningfully quieter than g22, so the sum|err| improvement is not the 939->592 artifact. The falsifier required the MECHANICAL counts to move for confirmation, and they did.
confirmations.ATTRIBUTION_IS_CONTESTED_AND_STAYS_THAT_: The mission brief and path_contract.py landed in the SAME session. 'The brief taught continuity' and 'the checker enforced the arithmetic' are both live explanations and THIS BLOCK CANNOT SEPARATE THEM. Recorded as confirmed on the measurement, unresolved on the mechanism (D37: the observation and the story are independent).
confirmations.read_and_not_used_check: NOT REFUTED on this limb either - every specialist named a SPECIFIC decision the brief changed (path drawn as a slope not a step; magnitude scale stated separately from the p50; overnight gap emitted 0 rather than manufactured). Two independently flagged the stakes/P&L paragraph as INERT and asked for it to be cut.
